thesis.core: Asset quality and provision coverage remain improved, but the defensive-equity case is still constrained by compressed NIM, a thinner core Tier-1 buffer and weak ordinary-share payout economics. The lower share price closes the valuation gap but does not create the required expected-return margin of safety.
thesis.variant_wedge: Low P/B is real, yet the discount remains economically justified until retained earnings convert into stronger core capital, stabilized NIM and a credible common-shareholder payout path.
thesis.normalized_earnings_basis: Retain 2026H1 ordinary BVPS RMB5.16 and normalized annual EPS RMB0.34-0.36; value primarily on common P/B because sustainable ROE, capital generation and payout capacity remain binding.

normalized_earnings_basis.rationale: Fresh review finds no post-H1 evidence that changes the capital/NIM/payout framework.

catalysts: Core Tier-1 capital ratio stabilizes and rebuilds without dilutive capital raising.
Net interest margin stabilizes as deposit repricing and asset mix improve.
Ordinary-share cash dividends resume at a sustainable payout level while asset quality remains stable.
kill_thesis: Core Tier-1 capital ratio moves materially closer to the regulatory floor or requires dilutive replenishment.
NIM continues to compress while ROE remains structurally below the cost of equity.
Asset-quality improvement reverses or ordinary-share payout remains structurally absent.
